description: Shezan International Limited has been a Pakistani food brand since 1964, making a range of products from the fruit and vegetables grown in its own orchards. The company describes itself as internationally recognised and sells on the quality and taste of its range.

products.name: Fruit and vegetable based foods
products.summary: The company makes its range from fruit and vegetables grown in its own orchards.
